name: ok-cli-prints
description: print() in a CLI entry point is output, not debug.

after.cli.py:
import argparse
from calc import add


def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('a', type=float)
    p.add_argument('b', type=float)
    a = p.parse_args()
    print(add(a.a, a.b))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
